titre: Part de la population connectée à Internet
sous_titre: en pourcentage de la population, en 2025

Pays à revenu élevé.texte: High-income countries are nearing universal Internet use with 94 per cent of the population using the Internet.

Asie-Pacifique.texte: In Asia-Pacific and the Arab States region, Internet use is at 77 and 70 per cent, respectively

Monde.texte: Today, in 2025, 74 per cent of the world's population are online, compared with 71 per cent a year earlier.

États arabes.texte: In Asia-Pacific and the Arab States region, Internet use is at 77 and 70 per cent, respectively

Afrique.texte: the average figure for Internet use for Africa is just 36 per cent

Pays à revenu faible.texte: only 23 per cent of the population of low-income countries are using the Internet
